item.title: Senate advances added legislative oversight on water project eminent domain
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — The Wyoming Senate advanced legislation this week that would place a new legislative checkpoint on the use of eminent domain for state-funded water development projects, requiring lawmakers to explicitly sign off before private property can be taken.
